Definition: of uncertain derivation; a fetter or manacle:--bonds, chain.
BiblicalUsage: Chains are what hold a prisoner fast, and the New Testament shows them holding Peter in Acts 12:6 until an angel strikes them off his hands in Acts 12:7. Paul wears them as an ambassador in Ephesians 6:20, and Revelation 20:1 turns the picture around, showing an angel with a great chain to bind the dragon himself.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe no chain is stronger than the God who breaks them, and no chain is too strong for the God who binds the enemy with one. What held Peter could not hold him when God sent his angel, and what binds Satan is the same power.
